name: youtube.scrape
description: Advisory check for a YouTube capture. The source must be named, quotes must come from a transcript or be omitted, and unclear rights stop the job.

source_named.instructions: The artifact contains a https://www.youtube.com/watch URL and the video title.

transcript_or_honest_gap.instructions: Every claimed quote is tied to a transcript, or the artifact says the transcript is missing and quotes nothing.

no_fabricated_quote.instructions: The artifact does not invent dialogue, timestamps, or claims the speaker did not make.

rights.instructions: The capture uses only a public title, description, or transcript. It does not use a logged-in session or a private video.

coverage.instructions: How complete is the capture relative to what it claims.
criteria: A URL with no captured text
A partial transcript, and the missing part is named
A transcript or an honest gap for every claimed quote, without the source URL
The full transcript text is in the artifact, with the source URL and a rights label

rules.reason: quote is not from a transcript
capture is too thin to use
capture rights are not public metadata

notes.bar: Pass line is above 0.9. A noul of 0.90 fails the rule `noul <= 0.90`; 0.91 or higher passes. Score and choice confidence use `confidence <= 0.90`. A score is a mean on levels 0..5, so above 0.9 of that scale is a mean above 4.50.
